name: canvas-video
description: Agent skill: design motion-graphics videos in HTML Canvas and render them to MP4, with optional Edge TTS narration and subtitles.
author: Chris Han <chris.han@castlery.org>

scripts.examples: for p in launch-keynote clear-explainer neon-circuit paper-sketch; do node scripts/cv.mjs render presets/$p --subs burn || exit 1; done && node scripts/cv.mjs render presets/swiss-kinetic --motion-blur 5
